metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to disable the 2023 Chrome UI by navigating to chrome://flags and searching for various flags ('rounded', 'New Tab', '2023', 'ChromeRefresh'). No relevant flag was found because the Chrome version (130) no longer exposes these UI controls as flags. Task reached the 50-turn limit.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can open the Chrome address bar, type chrome:// internal URLs, and navigate to chrome://flags successfully. The agent also reliably interacts with the flags search box.
metadata.failure_analysis: The original task is infeasible on Chrome 130: the 'Chrome Refresh 2023' flag was removed in later Chrome versions, so the UI cannot be reverted. The agent exhausted 50 turns searching for non-existent flags.
metadata.task_rationale: Extracted from the reliable prefix (steps 0-12): agent successfully navigated to chrome://flags. This simpler task verifies that demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: The evaluator checks the active tab URL using the accessibility tree. For chrome:// internal pages, the address bar shows the full URL. With goto_prefix='', active_url_from_accessTree returns the raw address bar text. is_expected_url_pattern_match verifies the URL contains 'chrome://flags'. Initial state (New Tab) does not pass.
